name: Gilead Sciences CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: Gilead Sciences, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company operating in the United States, Europe and other international markets that discovers, develops and commercializes medicines for serious health needs. Its portfolio includes HIV treatments such as Biktarvy, Genvoya, Descovy, Odefsey and Truvada, as well as Veklury, an injectable treatment for coronavirus disease.
